claims: Bill Self is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Kansas.
Bill Self has held the position of head men's basketball coach at the University of Kansas since 2003.
Bill Self has led the Jayhawks to two NCAA championships in 2008 and 2022.
Bill Self is the University of Kansas's all-time winningest coach.
Bill Self joined the University of Kansas in 2003.
Bill Self has completed 22+ seasons at the University of Kansas.
Bill Self previously coached at Oral Roberts.
Bill Self previously coached at Tulsa.
Bill Self previously coached at Illinois.
Bill Self won NCAA Championships in 2008 and 2022.
Bill Self was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame.
As of March 2026, Bill Self is actively leading the University of Kansas men's basketball team.
Brandon Schneider is the women's basketball head coach at the University of Kansas.
Brandon Schneider has been leading the University of Kansas women's basketball program since April 2015.
